newsitem.title: UK: UK wool sale benefits buyers, coarse types.
newsitem.headline: UK wool sale benefits buyers, coarse types.

text.p: The third Bradford sale of UK wool this year saw the market move in favour of buyers but prices for selected carpet types moved higher, the British Wool Marketing Board reported.
Halfbred hogs, Swaledales and Red Kempy Welsh all increased in value by around two-and-a-half percent and Picks and Supers were firm.
Mashams, Crosses, Radnors and most Welsh wools went against the seller.
Next season's wool made up twenty percent of the 2,260,781 kilo offering and sold at a significant premium, the Board said.
The sale achieved ninety percent clearance.
Further details will be available later.
